label: Bible Study
prompt: Faithful are the _____ of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verse: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
note: An honest friend's sting beats an enemy's flattering kisses.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I will pour water upon him that is _____, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verse: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
note: Water for the thirsty, and God's spirit poured out on your children — a promise for the next generation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of _____.
verse: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
note: The statue in Nebuchadnezzar's dream had a golden head — and feet of iron mixed with clay. Not a sturdy base.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For our _____ is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verse: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
note: KJV 'conversation' means way of life — Paul reminds Philippi, a Roman colony (Acts 16:12), where its true citizenship lies.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let nothing be done through strife or _____; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verse: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
note: 'Vainglory' is empty glory, conceit. Paul's cure: lowliness of mind, each esteeming others better than himself.
